<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Quorum Technology — Paquetes financieros para tu sitio web</title>
<meta name="description" content="Quorum Technology: freelancers que integran soluciones financieras (pagos, facturación, dashboards) en sitios web a la medida.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400;9..144,500;9..144,600;9..144,700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
--ink:#050505;
--ink-2:#151515;
--paper:#F5F5F3;
--paper-dim:#a8a8a4;
--brass:#FFFFFF;
--brass-soft:#FFFFFF;
--ledger-green:#1a1a1a;
--text-dark:#0A0A0A;
--line: rgba(245,245,243,0.12);
--line-strong: rgba(245,245,243,0.26);
--glow: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
--display: "Fraunces", serif;
--body: "Inter", sans-serif;
--mono: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
--maxw: 1180px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{
margin:0;
background:var(--ink);
color:var(--paper);
font-family:var(--body);
-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
overflow-x:hidden;
}
img,svg{display:block;max-width:100%;}
a{color:inherit;}
::selection{background:var(--brass);color:var(--ink);}
:focus-visible{
outline:2px solid var(--brass-soft);
outline-offset:3px;
}
.wrap{
max-width:var(--maxw);
margin:0 auto;
padding:0 32px;
}
/* ---------- Ledger background texture ---------- */
.ledger-bg{
position:fixed;
inset:0;
z-index:0;
pointer-events:none;
background-image:
repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, transparent 43px, var(--line) 43px, var(--line) 44px);
opacity:0.55;
}
.ledger-bg::before{
content:"";
position:absolute;
top:0; bottom:0; left:96px;
width:1px;
background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
}
@media (max-width:720px){
.ledger-bg::before{left:56px;}
}
main, header, footer{position:relative; z-index:1;}
/* ---------- Header ---------- */
header{
position:sticky;
top:0;
z-index:50;
background:rgba(14,27,43,0.86);
backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.nav{
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:space-between;
padding:18px 0;
}
.brand{
display:flex;
align-items:center;
gap:10px;
font-family:var(--display);
font-size:1.3rem;
font-weight:600;
letter-spacing:0.01em;
text-decoration:none;
}
.brand-mark{
width:34px;height:34px;
object-fit:contain;
flex-shrink:0;
filter:drop-shadow(0 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0));
transition:filter .3s ease;
}
.brand:hover .brand-mark{
filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.55));
}
.brand small{
display:block;
font-family:var(--mono);
font-size:0.6rem;
letter-spacing:0.18em;
color:var(--paper-dim);
font-weight:500;
text-transform:uppercase;
margin-top:2px;
}
nav.links{
display:flex;
gap:34px;
font-size:0.92rem;
}
nav.links a{
text-decoration:none;
color:var(--paper-dim);
transition:color .2s ease, text-shadow .2s ease;
position:relative;
}
nav.links a:hover{color:var(--paper); text-shadow:0 0 14px var(--glow);}
.nav-cta{
background:var(--brass);
color:var(--ink);
font-weight:600;
font-size:0.88rem;
padding:10px 20px;
border-radius:2px;
text-decoration:none;
transition:background .2s ease, transform .2s ease, box-shadow .25s ease;
}
.nav-cta:hover{background:var(--brass-soft); transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 0 22px var(--glow);}
.menu-toggle{display:none;}
@media (max-width:860px){
nav.links{display:none;}
.menu-toggle{
display:block;
background:none;
border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
color:var(--paper);
padding:8px 12px;
font-family:var(--mono);
font-size:0.75rem;
border-radius:2px;
}
}
/* ---------- Hero ---------- */
.hero{
padding:100px 0 90px;
border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
position:relative;
overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-mark{
position:absolute;
top:50%;
right:-90px;
width:520px;
height:auto;
transform:translateY(-50%);
opacity:0.07;
pointer-events:none;
animation:spin-slow 90s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes spin-slow{
from{transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(0deg);}
to{transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(360deg);}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
.hero-mark{animation:none;}
}
@media (max-width:860px){
.hero-mark{display:none;}
}
.eyebrow{
font-family:var(--mono);
font-size:0.75rem;
letter-spacing:0.22em;
text-transform:uppercase;
color:var(--brass-soft);
display:flex;
align-items:center;
gap:10px;
margin-bottom:26px;
}
.eyebrow::before{
content:"";
width:26px;height:1px;
background:var(--brass-soft);
}
.hero-grid{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:1.3fr 0.9fr;
gap:60px;
align-items:end;
}
h1{
font-family:var(--display);
font-weight:600;
font-size:clamp(2.4rem, 5.2vw, 4.3rem);
line-height:1.04;
letter-spacing:-0.01em;
margin:0 0 26px;
}
h1 em{
font-style:italic;
color:var(--brass-soft);
font-weight:500;
}
.hero-sub{
font-size:1.08rem;
line-height:1.6;
color:var(--paper-dim);
max-width:46ch;
margin:0 0 34px;
}
.hero-actions{
display:flex;
gap:16px;
flex-wrap:wrap;
margin-bottom:44px;
}
.btn-primary{
background:var(--brass);
color:var(--ink);
font-weight:600;
padding:14px 26px;
border-radius:2px;
text-decoration:none;
font-size:0.95rem;
transition:background .2s ease, transform .2s ease, box-shadow .25s ease;
border:1px solid var(--brass);
}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--brass-soft); transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 0 26px var(--glow);}
.btn-ghost{
padding:14px 26px;
border-radius:2px;
text-decoration:none;
font-size:0.95rem;
color:var(--paper);
border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
transition:border-color .2s ease, background .2s ease, box-shadow .25s ease;
}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--brass-soft); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,0.25);}
.hero-stats{
display:flex;
gap:36px;
font-family:var(--mono);
}
.hero-stats div{border-left:1px solid var(--line-strong); padding-left:14px;}
.hero-stats .num{font-size:1.5rem; color:var(--brass-soft); font-weight:600;}
.hero-stats .lbl{font-size:0.68rem; color:var(--paper-dim); letter-spacing:0.06em; margin-top:2px;}
/* Signature: mini statement card */
.statement{
background:var(--paper);
color:var(--text-dark);
border-radius:3px;
padding:26px 26px 22px;
box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
transform:rotate(1.2deg);
font-family:var(--mono);
transition:box-shadow .35s ease, transform .35s ease;
}
.statement:hover{
box-shadow:0 30px 70px -18px rgba(0,0,0,0.75), 0 0 46px rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
transform:rotate(0deg) translateY(-2px);
}
.statement-head{
display:flex;
justify-content:space-between;
align-items:baseline;
border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(16,22,31,0.25);
padding-bottom:12px;
margin-bottom:14px;
}
.statement-head .title{
font-family:var(--display);
font-size:1.1rem;
font-weight:600;
}
.statement-head .tag{
font-size:0.62rem;
letter-spacing:0.1em;
text-transform:uppercase;
background:var(--ledger-green);
color:var(--paper);
padding:3px 8px;
border-radius:2px;
}
.statement-row{
display:flex;
justify-content:space-between;
font-size:0.82rem;
padding:7px 0;
border-bottom:1px solid rgba(16,22,31,0.08);
}
.statement-row span:first-child{color:rgba(16,22,31,0.6);}
.statement-total{
display:flex;
justify-content:space-between;
padding-top:14px;
margin-top:6px;
font-size:1rem;
font-weight:600;
}
.statement-total .amt{color:var(--ledger-green);}
.statement-foot{
margin-top:16px;
font-size:0.66rem;
color:rgba(16,22,31,0.45);
letter-spacing:0.03em;
}
/* ---------- Section shared ---------- */
section{padding:88px 0;}
.section-head{
max-width:640px;
margin-bottom:56px;
}
.section-head h2{
font-family:var(--display);
font-size:clamp(1.8rem, 3.4vw, 2.6rem);
font-weight:600;
margin:0 0 16px;
line-height:1.15;
}
.section-head p{
color:var(--paper-dim);
line-height:1.6;
font-size:1rem;
margin:0;
}
.divider{border:none;border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
/* ---------- Servicios ---------- */
.services{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.service-grid{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
gap:1px;
background:var(--line);
border:1px solid var(--line);
}
.service-card{
background:var(--ink);
padding:34px 30px;
transition:background .25s ease, box-shadow .3s ease;
position:relative;
}
.service-card:hover{
background:var(--ink-2);
box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.18), 0 0 34px rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
}
.service-card .idx{
font-family:var(--mono);
font-size:0.72rem;
color:var(--brass-soft);
letter-spacing:0.1em;
margin-bottom:18px;
display:block;
}
.service-card h3{
font-family:var(--display);
font-size:1.25rem;
font-weight:600;
margin:0 0 10px;
}
.service-card p{
color:var(--paper-dim);
font-size:0.92rem;
line-height:1.6;
margin:0;
}
@media (max-width:860px){
.service-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}
/* ---------- Paquetes (pricing ledger) ---------- */
.packages{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.plan-toggle-note{
font-family:var(--mono);
font-size:0.78rem;
color:var(--paper-dim);
margin-bottom:40px;
}
.plans{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
gap:22px;
}
.plan{
border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
border-radius:3px;
padding:34px 28px;
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
position:relative;
background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.03), transparent 40%);
transition:box-shadow .3s ease, border-color .3s ease, transform .3s ease;
}
.plan:hover{
border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
transform:translateY(-3px);
}
.plan.featured{
border-color:var(--brass);
background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.09), transparent 55%);
box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
}
.plan.featured:hover{
box-shadow:0 0 50px rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
}
.plan.featured::before{
content:"Más contratado";
position:absolute;
top:-13px;
left:28px;
background:var(--brass);
color:var(--ink);
font-family:var(--mono);
font-size:0.65rem;
letter-spacing:0.06em;
padding:4px 10px;
border-radius:2px;
font-weight:600;
}
.plan-name{
font-family:var(--mono);
font-size:0.72rem;
letter-spacing:0.14em;
text-transform:uppercase;
color:var(--brass-soft);
margin-bottom:10px;
}
.plan h3{
font-family:var(--display);
font-size:1.5rem;
font-weight:600;
margin:0 0 14px;
}
.plan-price{
font-family:var(--mono);
display:flex;
align-items:baseline;
gap:6px;
margin-bottom:6px;
}
.plan-price .amount{font-size:2.1rem; font-weight:600;}
.plan-price .period{font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--paper-dim);}
.plan-desc{
color:var(--paper-dim);
font-size:0.88rem;
line-height:1.55;
margin:0 0 26px;
padding-bottom:26px;
border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line-strong);
}
.plan-features{
list-style:none;
margin:0 0 30px;
padding:0;
flex-grow:1;
}
.plan-features li{
font-size:0.88rem;
padding:8px 0;
display:flex;
gap:10px;
color:var(--paper);
border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.plan-features li:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.plan-features li::before{
content:"—";
color:var(--brass-soft);
flex-shrink:0;
}
.plan-cta{
text-align:center;
padding:13px;
border-radius:2px;
text-decoration:none;
font-weight:600;
font-size:0.9rem;
border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
color:var(--paper);
transition:all .25s ease;
}
.plan.featured .plan-cta{
background:var(--brass);
color:var(--ink);
border-color:var(--brass);
}
.plan-cta:hover{border-color:var(--brass-soft); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,0.25);}
.plan.featured .plan-cta:hover{background:var(--brass-soft); box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(255,255,255,0.4);}
@media (max-width:940px){
.plans{grid-template-columns:1fr; max-width:440px; margin:0 auto;}
}
/* ---------- Proceso ---------- */
.process{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.process-list{
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
}
.process-item{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;
gap:30px;
padding:26px 0;
border-top:1px solid var(--line);
}
.process-item:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.process-item .step{
font-family:var(--mono);
color:var(--brass-soft);
font-size:0.95rem;
}
.process-item h4{
font-family:var(--display);
font-size:1.15rem;
font-weight:600;
margin:0 0 8px;
}
.process-item p{
color:var(--paper-dim);
font-size:0.92rem;
line-height:1.6;
margin:0;
max-width:60ch;
}
@media (max-width:600px){
.process-item{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:8px;}
}
/* ---------- Confianza / por qué nosotros ---------- */
.trust{
border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.trust-grid{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
gap:60px;
align-items:center;
}
.trust-copy p{
color:var(--paper-dim);
line-height:1.7;
font-size:1rem;
}
.trust-list{
list-style:none;
padding:0;
margin:26px 0 0;
display:grid;
gap:14px;
}
.trust-list li{
display:flex;
gap:12px;
font-size:0.95rem;
align-items:flex-start;
}
.trust-list .mark{
font-family:var(--mono);
color:var(--brass-soft);
flex-shrink:0;
}
.metric-card{
border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
border-radius:3px;
padding:30px;
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
gap:24px;
}
.metric{
padding:16px 0;
}
.metric .val{
font-family:var(--mono);
font-size:2rem;
color:var(--brass-soft);
font-weight:600;
}
.metric .lbl{
font-size:0.8rem;
color:var(--paper-dim);
margin-top:6px;
}
@media (max-width:860px){
.trust-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:36px;}
}
/* ---------- CTA final ---------- */
.final-cta{
text-align:center;
padding:100px 0;
border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.final-cta h2{
font-family:var(--display);
font-size:clamp(2rem, 4.4vw, 3.2rem);
font-weight:600;
max-width:16ch;
margin:0 auto 20px;
line-height:1.1;
}
.final-cta p{
color:var(--paper-dim);
max-width:50ch;
margin:0 auto 34px;
line-height:1.6;
}
.final-actions{
display:flex;
justify-content:center;
gap:16px;
flex-wrap:wrap;
}
/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
footer{
padding:50px 0 40px;
}
.footer-grid{
display:flex;
justify-content:space-between;
align-items:flex-start;
gap:30px;
flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.footer-brand p{
color:var(--paper-dim);
font-size:0.85rem;
max-width:34ch;
margin:12px 0 0;
line-height:1.6;
}
.footer-cols{
display:flex;
gap:60px;
flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.footer-col h5{
font-family:var(--mono);
font-size:0.7rem;
letter-spacing:0.12em;
text-transform:uppercase;
color:var(--brass-soft);
margin:0 0 14px;
}
.footer-col a{
display:block;
color:var(--paper-dim);
text-decoration:none;
font-size:0.88rem;
padding:5px 0;
transition:color .2s ease, text-shadow .2s ease;
}
.footer-col a:hover{color:var(--paper); text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--glow);}
.footer-bottom{
margin-top:50px;
padding-top:24px;
border-top:1px solid var(--line);
display:flex;
justify-content:space-between;
font-family:var(--mono);
font-size:0.72rem;
color:var(--paper-dim);
flex-wrap:wrap;
gap:10px;
}
/* ---------- Reveal on scroll ---------- */
.reveal{
opacity:0;
transform:translateY(18px);
transition:opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease;
}
.reveal.in{
opacity:1;
transform:translateY(0);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
.reveal{opacity:1; transform:none; transition:none;}
.btn-primary:hover, .nav-cta:hover{transform:none;}
}
</style>
</head>

<!-- PROCESO -->
<section class="process" id="proceso">
<div class="wrap">
<div class="section-head reveal">
<h2>Cómo trabajamos</h2>
<p>Cuatro pasos, del primer mensaje al sitio cobrando.</p>
</div>
<div class="process-list">
<div class="process-item reveal">
<div class="step">01</div>
<div><h4>Diagnóstico</h4><p>Entendemos tu negocio, cómo cobras hoy y qué te está haciendo perder tiempo o dinero.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="process-item reveal">
<div class="step">02</div>
<div><h4>Propuesta y paquete</h4><p>Te recomendamos el paquete adecuado y dejamos claro qué incluye, en cuánto tiempo y por qué precio.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="process-item reveal">
<div class="step">03</div>
<div><h4>Construcción</h4><p>Diseñamos, desarrollamos e integramos los pagos y reportes, con avances que puedes revisar.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="process-item reveal">
<div class="step">04</div>
<div><h4>Lanzamiento y soporte</h4><p>Publicamos el sitio, verificamos que los cobros funcionen y quedamos disponibles para ajustes.</p></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- POR QUÉ NOSOTROS -->
<section class="trust" id="nosotros">
<div class="wrap trust-grid">
<div class="trust-copy reveal">
<div class="eyebrow">Por qué Quorum</div>
<h2 style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3vw,2.4rem);font-weight:600;margin:0 0 4px;line-height:1.15;">Somos freelancers, pero trabajamos como firma</h2>
<p>Cada proyecto pasa por diseño, desarrollo y una revisión de que el dinero realmente fluye bien: sin cobros perdidos, sin facturas manuales, sin reportes armados a mano.</p>
<ul class="trust-list">
<li><span class="mark">—</span> Comunicación directa con quien construye tu sitio, sin intermediarios.</li>
<li><span class="mark">—</span> Precios claros por paquete, sin cargos ocultos.</li>
<li><span class="mark">—</span> Integraciones probadas antes de la entrega, no después.</li>
<li><span class="mark">—</span> Documentación simple para que tu equipo sepa usar lo que construimos.</li>
</ul>
